title: Parts Manager - F. Inspection at 100 percent but not submitted shows Open
preconds: Logged in as Parts Manager. An inspection can be filled to 100 percent without submitting.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Fill all inspection items to 100 percent but do NOT click Submit and Generate Report.
3. Observe the inspection status on the line.
expected:
Step 2: All items show filled (100 percent).
Step 3: The inspection still shows "Open" (not "Completed") until Submit and Generate Report is clicked.
